item.title: Ask for a locker reset
item.context_text: Your backpack is in a gym locker, but the keypad does not open. Read the sign before you go to the desk.
item.objective_text: Give the locker number and follow the reset procedure.
success_conditions: Give the locker number and follow the reset procedure.

children.title: Read the situation
children.instructions: Read the information and answer both questions.
children.prompt_text:
GYM LOCKERS
For a locker that won't open, report its number at the front desk. Bring your membership card or today's guest receipt. Staff can reset keys after the swimming lesson ends at 16:20. Please wait at the desk rather than pulling on the locker door. You have a guest receipt and locker 18.

questions.explanation: The receipt is an accepted alternative to a membership card.

questions.prompt: What is the earliest staff can reset the locker?
options: As soon as you pull the door
questions.explanation: The notice says resets are available after the lesson finishes.

children.title: Tell your friend why you're late
children.prompt_text: Friend: Are you ready to leave?
children.instructions: Say why you are delayed and when someone can help.
children.model_answer: My locker won't open, so I'm waiting at the desk. Someone can reset it after 16:20. I'll message you when I have my bag.

children.title: Ask the desk for help
children.prompt_text: Staff member: What seems to be the problem?
children.instructions: Give the locker number and offer the correct document.
children.model_answer: Could you open locker eighteen, please? My backpack is inside. I have today's guest receipt here.
